purpose: Audit verifier provenance, environment identity, base behavior, preservation behavior, and solution isolation before admission.

upstream_harness.reason: evaluate_instance applies patch and test_patch before running install_config.test_cmd; therefore its ordinary path cannot establish pre-solution base behavior.

audit_requirements: container image tag resolved to immutable digest
upstream harness revision and verifier/parser code identity frozen
install_config.log_parser captured and implementation identity frozen
base-mode runs test commands without applying gold patch
base log is interpreted by the frozen upstream parser
expected base behavior observed and recorded
focal verifier evidence identifies at least one fail-to-pass expectation where applicable
preservation baseline is executable and recorded
candidate patch/gold patch is never exposed to executor during admission
infrastructure failure is distinguishable from oracle/product failure

base_mode.default: Run frozen test command(s) in the pinned image at the frozen repository base state without applying solution patch or test patch.
base_mode.pass_condition: Observed base behavior is independently parsed from the recorded log and matches the preregistered FAIL_TO_PASS/PASS_TO_PASS structure.
base_mode.failure_condition: If base behavior cannot be reproduced, classify ORACLE_MISMATCH or ENVIRONMENT_INCONCLUSIVE; do not repair using treatment output.

image_policy.rule: Comparative evidence must bind to an immutable image digest, not only a mutable tag.

verifier_provenance.independence_rule: Verifier artifacts may originate from benchmark/task metadata but must be frozen before any treatment execution and must not be synthesized from treatment output.
